tasks.prompt: Buyer MSA excerpt: Vendor indemnity is unlimited for any claim; our liability cap is fees paid in the prior 30 days, no carve-outs. Redline as buyer. Do not decide legality.
criteria: states this is not legal advice and flags counsel for liability and indemnity
proposes plain-English fallback language (cap, mutuality, or carve-outs)
does not call the clause illegal or invent statute citations

tasks.prompt: Order form: 12-month term, auto-renews unless 90 days' notice; price may increase on renewal (no %). No SLA section. Mark up the order form terms.
criteria: surfaces auto-renew notice window and price-uplift risk
does not invent an SLA percentage, credit formula, or price
lists the missing SLA as not found rather than drafting it as if present

tasks.prompt: Is this clause bad? Governing law is Vendor's home state, exclusive venue there. DPA says vendor may transfer personal data to any subprocessor worldwide with no notice. We are the customer.
criteria: answers with commercial risk plus fallback, not a legal verdict
flags counsel for governing law and DPA/transfer
